title: `cart.getTotal()` now returns a Promise and isn't awaited
body: `getTotal` became async in this PR, so `total` is a Promise here. `total <= 0` is always false, which means an empty cart can check out.

title: `refund` doesn't check who is asking
body: Any caller can refund any order: `refund` never compares the order's owner with the signed-in user.
